purpose: Native evidence for the A7 via-mode SMD pin-feed residual. Sonnet Lite 18.53 non-de-embedded solves of a two-pad 10-ohm IDEAL component project (sweep.son, GNDREF BOX pins) versus two literal-via controls. The literal-via control path matches DiffMoM to ~7e-5, while the component pin path carries a systematic +0.002+0.013i (1 GHz) to +0.009+0.025i (2 GHz) frequency-linear residual per pin — a fixed ~0.13nH pin-feed/junction inductance difference between Lite's subcell pin-flap model and the cell-column via representation, independent of via length and mesh refinement. Lite's own mesh accounting (Via:4 at level 0 for two 2-cell pins) matches the cell-column structure, and the raw 4-port geo response shows the residual concentrated in the pin port self/coupling terms.
